_meta.decision: Q27 v1 remainders (R6, R8, R9); numbers minted at merge in DECISIONS_LOG
_meta.rule: G3 amended (R8): NO NUMBER FIRES A VERDICT. Each record is a published reference value, admitted as DATA for display. engine/reference.py shows a record as a band ONLY when an observation's protocol is one the record lists; engine/norms.py exposes no comparison function; nothing in the tier turns a band into a pass, a fail, a grade or a clearance.
_meta.shape: target = {region, measure} or {ratio}; protocols = engine/protocols.py keys the record was cited for; unit = the measure's unit, 'ratio', '<unit>/kg' (normalisation per_body_mass_kg) or 'ratio' with normalisation per_body_weight (force divided by body weight); value = {mean, sd} | {median} | {low, high}; verified_against = full_text | abstract_only.
_meta.body_mass_source: load_events.BODYWEIGHT_KG (the only body-mass source in code); surfaced in every response that uses it.
